quality_notes: parse_amendment_pdf.py found 3 of the Act's 6 sections: the marginal notes on page 2 sit in the left margin and the parser ran sections 4, 5 and 6 into the text of section 3 (kept in body_as_parsed). The body was rebuilt by hand from the same text layer (pdftotext -layout under PowerShell): section 1's embedded marginal note removed from its text, section 3 cut at 'substituted therefor:-' with the substituted section 20 as an inserted provision, sections 4-6 added, and the substituted section 12's '(2) (a)' restored as subsection (2) paragraph (a). The validator's 'contains the start of section 4/5' warnings on the parsed section 3 no longer apply.
Inserted section 12(2)(a): the print reads 'Gezette'; kept as printed.
Section 3 of the Act (replacing section 20): the marginal note in the print is 'The Bank to raise money by the issue of debentures for granting medium term and long term loans.'
Long title and section 2 cite the principal enactment as 'People's Bank Act, No. 29 of 1961', matching registry row SRC080.

provenance.what_changed: Rebuilt the six-section body from the text layer (parser output kept in body_as_parsed); added amendment_instructions for sections 4 and 5; added quality_notes. Wording transcribed from the print, not altered.
